name: Tun Mutahir’s household
goals: Keep access to hearings when the merchants bring competing claims.
Find another sponsor if an official’s household can no longer protect its people.
bio: The Bendahara’s kin can bring petitions to court; they do not all hold the same office. Salmah brings watch reports through the temenggung’s people. Dues and customs rulings are filed in the temenggung’s name.
notes: fact: Brown distinguishes Mutahir, his son Hasan and the treasury officer Tahir; Pires describes the temenggung as Customs Judge and receiver of merchandise dues (Brown ch. XXII, pp. 160–164; Pires II, pp. 265, 273)
gameplay: Salmah’s patronage is fiction, and the player is a shahbandar whose port-wide remit is a gameplay abstraction (port-labour.md §§2, 4; port-official.md §4)
